title: RtppluginPRO
description: Plugin that you can random teleport with. It has nice gui.
body:
RtpPlugin

Simple and fast random teleport plugin for Paper, Spigot, and Purpur servers with a dimension selection GUI.

Features

Random teleport system
Dimension selection GUI
Supports Overworld, Nether, and End
Fast and lightweight
Simple configuration

Use /rtp to open the teleport menu.
